basic_info.description: Just steps away from Bernal Heights Park! Amazing views and natural light featuring four bedrooms, three and a half bathrooms, and over 600 square feet of bonus space. The open floor plan connects a chef's kitchen to the living and dining areas, complete with a custom gas fireplace. The spacious master suite includes a walk-in closet, double sinks, and a private deck with amazing views of the SF Bay. 2 bonus rooms that could be used as gym or playroom for extra flexibility. Multiple decks with stunning views, a landscaped garden, and a luxurious hot tub. Situated on a quiet cul-de-sac, Franconia just a few blocks away from Precita Park and Precita Park cafe. A true Bernal Heights treasure!
